title: Rav Aryeh Zilberstein Passes
body: Rav Aryeh Zilberstein zt”l, 67, rov of Gerer kehillah in Bnei Brak, passes away at Hadassah Ein Kerem. Levayah begins in Yerushalayim.

title: Rabbi Pindrus Joins Chaim V'Chessed
body: Rabbi Yitzchak Pindrus, former Knesset member, joins Chaim V'Chessed as Senior Governmental Liaison, marking a significant milestone for the organization supporting Olim in Israel.
